properties.name: auto_validate
properties.comment: How focus changes validate the controls they leave (Windows Forms' AutoValidate); inherit takes the nearest container's policy (effective_auto_validate resolves it). A change raises auto_validate_changed. A value outside the AutoValidate choices throws std::invalid_argument.
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("GUI.Forms AutoValidate value is invalid");

not_properties.name: effective_auto_validate
not_properties.reason: read-only, resolved through the container ancestry

not_properties.name: active_control
not_properties.reason: run-time focus state, changed through request_active_control and clear_active_control
